title: SAR Doppler tomography research started in 2018

tellings.quote: time 6 or 7 years, we we began 2 years before the the papers. So, in 2018

plain: A team studying the pyramids of Giza in Egypt began in 2018 to use satellite radar to build pictures of what lies under the ground, a method called radar Doppler tomography. Filippo Biondi, a researcher who led the work, says they started about two years before publishing their papers and have now been at it six or seven years. He tells it as background to his claim of large structures hidden beneath the pyramids.
